question.text: Stock A has beta 1.2 and Stock B has beta 1.1. Portfolio is 60% A + 40% B. Portfolio beta is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Portfolio beta = weighted avg: 0.6 × 1.2 + 0.4 × 1.1 = 0.72 + 0.44 = 1.16. The Trap: 1.15 is an average; 1.50 is sum. Cross-Exam Context: Foundational; Topic 16 also tests. Manager's Pro-Tip: Portfolio beta is linear-weighted; std deviation is NOT linear-weighted (unless correlation = 1).
